project.name: KnotzDoom
project.description: A complete Doom-style raycasting first person shooter in Python 3.10+ with pygame 2.5+ and numpy. Six levels, four weapons, five monster types, keys/secrets/doors, full menu flow, saves, cheats, automap.
project.window: 1600x900 logical, pygame SCALED fallback on smaller desktops, F11 fullscreen
project.license_note: Original sprite/texture pack is classic-Doom inspired; new art, sounds and music are procedurally generated by tools/gen_assets.py.

how_to_verify.tests: SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy python -m pytest tests -q   (70 tests, ~15 s, headless; user data goes to a temp dir via KNOTZDOOM_DATA_DIR)
how_to_verify.lint: python -m pyflakes knotzdoom tools tests main.py   (must be silent)
how_to_verify.smoke_walkthrough: python tools/smoke_test.py <out_dir>  (drives every state, saves screenshots)
how_to_verify.golden_images: tests/golden/*.txt hashes of downscaled frames; after an intentional visual change run KNOTZDOOM_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 pytest tests/test_rendering.py

architecture.loop: Game.run -> Game.frame: clock tick -> DetailController.record_frame -> check_events (top state) -> state.update(dt ms, clamped to 60) -> draw states from the lowest non-transparent one -> display.flip
architecture.state_stack: Game.states list; push/pop/replace/clear_states; State.enter/exit/resume/handle_event/update/draw; State.transparent=True draws the state below first (DeathState). MenuState base handles Esc, menu navigation, demo backdrop and heading.
architecture.flow: knotzdoom/flow.py: start_new_game -> intro StoryState -> begin_level (per-level story) -> start_level (PlayState) -> World.trigger_exit -> level_complete (IntermissionState) -> begin_level(next) ... -> finish_episode (outro StoryState -> VictoryState -> Credits -> Title). save_game/load_game also live here.
architecture.world: World = one loaded level: walls dict + flat cells list for the raycaster (>0 texture, <0 -(door index+1)), doors, solid_tiles, Player, ObjectHandler (npcs/pickups/props/projectiles/particles), PathFinding flow field, Effects (flash/shake), stats, secrets, messages. World.update(dt) drives everything; World.save_state/restore_state serialise it.
architecture.rendering: Renderer(game, world, divisor) owns a View (view.py) whose surface is the window at divisor 1 or a half-size surface at 2 (present() scales it up). RayCaster.cast fills results[(depth, proj_height, tex, u, x_side)] and a numpy depth buffer; draw_walls scales 1-texel strips from lazily built shade banks straight into the view; sprites project (tangent projection) into draw requests, are sorted far-to-near, shaded at source size via an LRU, converted to colorkey at load when alpha is binary, and clipped per column against the depth buffer.
architecture.raycasting: knotzdoom/raycasting.py: walk() is one DDA over world.cells with sliding door slabs on tile centre lines; shared by RayCaster.cast (per column), trace() and line_of_sight() (monster sight, splash damage) and World.hitscan (world-space pellets vs collision circles). Camera outside the grid (idclip) draws only sky.
architecture.ai: NPC state machine idle -> chase <-> attack, pain interrupts, dying -> dead corpse. Sight every LOS_INTERVAL ms; hearing via World.noise using flow-field path distance; movement toward PathFinding.next_step with corner-cut prevention; monsters open unlocked doors, never locked or secret ones; melee/hitscan/fireball/rocket attacks in NPC_DEFS.
architecture.detail_levels: config detail auto|high|low. DetailController switches auto mode to low when the average raw frame exceeds 19 ms for 1.5 s and back below 7 ms. Renderer.set_detail rebuilds the view on change; weapons keep per-divisor scaled frames.

modules.knotzdoom/settings.py: constants: resolution, FOV, MAX_DEPTH, shading, player, mouse, door, timing, gameplay, DIFFICULTIES table, data paths (KNOTZDOOM_DATA_DIR)
modules.knotzdoom/config.py: Config with SCHEMA (type/range/choices), coerce(), load/save config.json
modules.knotzdoom/assets.py: Assets: wall_bank (lazy shade levels), sky, digits, raw_frames/frames/frame/sprite_frames, weapon_frames, tint_surface variants, to_colorkey
modules.knotzdoom/fonts.py: BigFont (glowing red), PixelFont, DigitFont, format_time, Fonts registry; LRU caches of 512
modules.knotzdoom/audio.py: Audio: SFX_FILES/MUSIC_FILES tables, play(name, volume, pos) with distance attenuation, music control
modules.knotzdoom/level.py: grid legend (module docstring), LevelData parser, DoorSpec/Thing, load_level (validates), load_episode, validate_level, reachable_tiles
modules.knotzdoom/renderer.py: Renderer: set_detail, render, draw_background/walls/sprites, shaded_source LRU, overlay, screen_overlay, shake, present
modules.knotzdoom/player.py: Player: inventory (weapons/ammo/keys/armor), movement with wall sliding, mouse look (frame-rate independent), use(), take_damage, weapon switching, carry_state/full_state
modules.knotzdoom/weapons.py: WEAPON_DEFS table, WEAPON_SLOTS, Weapon (fire, animation, draw into the view)
modules.knotzdoom/pickups.py: PICKUP_DEFS/PICKUP_EFFECTS tables, PROP_DEFS, Pickup, Prop, Barrel
modules.knotzdoom/pathfinding.py: PathFinding flow field: passable, build_graph, refresh_tile, flood, next_step, distance
modules.knotzdoom/objects.py: ObjectHandler: spawn_from_level (difficulty skip), update, spawn_* effects, save/restore
modules.knotzdoom/hud.py: HUD: composed status bar (LAYOUT table), face states, messages, crosshair, automap layer
modules.knotzdoom/ui/menu.py: draw_dim, draw_skull, is_confirm/is_back/is_enter, blinking, State, MenuItem, Menu, MenuState
modules.knotzdoom/ui/screens.py: TitleState, MainMenuState, DifficultyState, OptionsState, HelpState, CreditsState, StoryState, IntermissionState, VictoryState
modules.knotzdoom/ui/play.py: PlayState (input, cheats, update, draw), PauseState, SaveLoadState, DeathState
modules.knotzdoom/saves.py: write_save (atomic), read_save_status/validate (version, level fingerprint), slot_summaries, MIGRATIONS hook
modules.knotzdoom/game.py: Game: window, clock, assets/fonts/audio, records.json, state stack, flow delegators, draw_backdrop, frame/run
modules.levels/episode.json: title, level order, intro/outro text, tips, credits
modules.tools/: gen_assets.py (procedural art/sound/music), optimize_assets.py, smoke_test.py, autoplay.py, timedemo.py, perf_test.py, level_map.py, screenshots.py
modules.tests/: test_levels, test_raycasting, test_pathfinding, test_gameplay, test_regressions (one per review bug), test_rendering (golden + perf), test_view, test_assets, test_autoplay, test_game_flow
modules.docs/findings.md: third-party performance/quality review with a status table of what was done

level_json.legend: see knotzdoom/level.py docstring: # walls, 1-9 textures, D door, R/B/Y locked doors, S secret door, X exit switch wall, . floor, ~ secret floor, P start; enemies z g c k C; weapons s m l p; ammo u U e E q Q; health h H o a A; keys r b y; props % | T t j J
level_json.rules: solid border; doors embedded in walls with floor on both sides across the doorway; exit X must have a reachable floor neighbour; keys reachable before their doors; sightlines under ~22 tiles (MAX_DEPTH 24); max 40x40; validate with knotzdoom.level.validate_level (load_level raises LevelError otherwise); tools/level_map.py renders a preview; tools/autoplay.py proves completability

save_json.fields: level_index, level_name, level_hash (sha1 of grid), difficulty, difficulty_name, session, carry (level-start inventory), world (World.save_state: time, stats, player, doors, objects, found_areas, seen), timestamp, date
save_json.notes: written atomically; validate() rejects other versions (add MIGRATIONS[old_version]) and mismatched level hashes; fused barrels and in-flight projectiles are not saved

data_formats.config_json: keys per config.SCHEMA: music_volume, sfx_volume, mouse_sensitivity, crosshair, screen_shake, show_fps, always_run, fullscreen, head_bob, fps_cap (0/30/60/90/120/144), detail (auto/high/low); invalid values are coerced or ignored

assets.sprites: resources/sprites/<dir>/<frames>.png sorted by name; npc/<kind>/{idle,walk,attack,pain,death}; weapon/<name>/0.png idle then firing frames; pickups, decorations, projectiles, animated_sprites, static_sprites
assets.music: resources/music/*.wav loops + resources/sound/theme.mp3, registered in audio.MUSIC_FILES
assets.generation: python tools/gen_assets.py [--only textures|sprites|sounds|music] [--contact-sheet path]; deterministic; do not hand edit generated files, change the generator

conventions.units: world units = tiles; angles in radians (0 = +x, positive = clockwise on screen since y grows downward); dt in milliseconds; speeds in tiles per second for monsters/projectiles and tiles per millisecond for the player (PLAYER_SPEED)
conventions.sprite_placement: scale = height in wall units; z = height above the floor; bright = ignore distance shading; bleeds = spawns blood; radius = collision circle for shots
conventions.tables_first: new content goes into definition tables (NPC_DEFS, WEAPON_DEFS, PICKUP_DEFS/PICKUP_EFFECTS, PROP_DEFS, PROJECTILE_DEFS, SFX_FILES, THING_LEGEND) rather than new classes
conventions.hot_loops: RayCaster.cast/walk and Renderer.draw_walls/draw_sprites are per-column Python; keep attribute lookups out of them and measure with tools/perf_test.py and tools/timedemo.py before and after
conventions.constants: no magic numbers in modules; add to settings.py blocks (doors, timing, gameplay)
conventions.imports: no import cycles: ui -> world/renderer/hud, flow -> ui, game -> flow+ui; keep game.py free of local imports
conventions.style: pyflakes clean, 120 columns, docstrings on modules and public methods, no em dashes in text
conventions.tests: every bug fix gets a regression test in tests/test_regressions.py; visual changes update golden hashes deliberately
conventions.git: feature branches merged into master; commit messages describe behaviour, not files

add_a_weapon: draw frames under resources/sprites/weapon/<name>/ (frame 0 idle, then firing frames) or add a generator in tools/gen_assets.py
add an entry to weapons.WEAPON_DEFS (slot, ammo, damage, pellets, spread, rate, frame_time, sound, height, kick, kind hitscan|rocket)
add a pickup: PICKUP_DEFS entry + WEAPON_PICKUPS + level legend char in level.THING_LEGEND
HUD arms panel shows slots 1-4; extend LAYOUT/arms loop for more
add_a_monster: frames under resources/sprites/npc/<name>/{idle,walk,attack,pain,death}/ or reuse a set with a tint variant (assets.tint_surface modes)
NPC_DEFS entry (hp, speed, attack kind, damage, range, cooldown, pain_chance, frame times, fire_frame, score, sight)
for a new attack kind extend NPC.perform_attack
add_a_level: copy a levels/e1mN.json, edit the grid per the legend
append the id to levels/episode.json levels
python -c "from knotzdoom.level import load_level; load_level('e1m7')" must not raise
python tools/autoplay.py e1m7 and tools/level_map.py to check
add_an_option: read it where needed via game.config[key]
add_a_sound: put a wav in resources/sound and register it in audio.SFX_FILES (BASE_VOLUMES optional)
play with world.audio.play(name, pos=...) for attenuation
add_a_pickup: PICKUP_DEFS (image/frames, scale, z, msg, sound) + PICKUP_EFFECTS callable + THING_LEGEND char
change_visuals: run KNOTZDOOM_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 pytest tests/test_rendering.py after confirming the change on screenshots (tools/screenshots.py)

known_limitations_and_backlog: No vertical look, no floor/ceiling textures (flat gradient floor, sky ceiling), single-height walls: inherent to the grid raycaster
Music ships as WAV (12 MB); convert to OGG when an encoder is available (pygame plays OGG)
Fused barrels and in-flight projectiles are not serialised in saves
Wall phase is still ~4 ms at high detail (C-level scale per column); further wins need a different column strategy or default low detail
No CI configuration; add a workflow running pyflakes + pytest (headless) and the perf marker
Mouse feel and audio mix have only been validated headless; needs a human playtest on a real display
Per-level enemy placement for difficulty is a skip rule (ROOKIE removes every 3rd monster); Doom-style per-skill spawn flags are not implemented
Save/Load menu shows 4 slots; no slot naming or deletion UI
Monster infighting, item respawn and multiplayer are out of scope
ideas_for_next_features: Plasma rifle / BFG using the projectile system (PROJECTILE_DEFS + weapon kind 'projectile')
Doom-style per-skill monster flags in the level format (e.g. lowercase/uppercase variants or a things list)
Textured floors via numpy floor casting at low detail
Monster alert/sight sounds and death cries per kind
Level statistics screen and per-level best times in records.json
Episode 2 with new procedurally generated texture themes

sessions: 1: prototype rebuilt into a full game (engine package, six levels, generated assets, UI flow, tools, tests)
2: third-party review (docs/findings.md) and optimisation pass: shared DDA raycaster, faster walls/sprites, detail levels, bug fixes, robustness, ui package split; 11.5 -> 6.0 ms per frame
3: merge to master, repo cleanup, this handoff
